problem_or_trigger: A finite control search failed and a structural change is being considered.
principle: Separate control-search limits from structural limits: inspect the actual input domain, then test a changed control search or relevant drive/braking mechanism. Local failure and local mechanism improvement do not establish full-task feasibility.
assumptions: Current model, condition, state and legal absolute-tension bounds are authoritative.
diagnostic_questions: What were the starting sequence, correction bound, search radii, knots, physical bounds and stop reason?
Does a relevant state show weak drive toward the position error or weak braking at nonzero velocity?
possible_actions: Choose a lawful different start, wider correction domain, parameterization or registered method; alternatively inspect a relevant mechanism. No fixed order is prescribed.
Preserve successful same-structure condition controls. After a structural change, reoptimize every required condition and independently replay before joint SELECT.
expected_observations: Improvement with changed controls weakens the structural-limitation explanation; weak relevant directional drive motivates a targeted structural hypothesis.
weakening_observations: A local mechanism improvement without full-task improvement weakens the proposed mechanism-to-task link.
applicability: Conditional tendon-robot research method; cross-task transfer unverified. Neither solver limits nor weak local drive prove global infeasibility.
historical_source: Operator-organized M1 continuation and structural readaptation; not a Main autonomous discovery. Winning design, controls and result files withheld.
validation_status: Procedural history assistance only; Knowledge-assisted evaluation, no current scientific evidence.
